key_findings: Anemoside B4 relieves collagen-induced arthritis pain by inhibiting spinal GSK-3β, raising Nrf2/GPX4 antioxidant signalling and suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
GSK-3β knockdown in C6 cells reduced Drp1 and NLRP3 protein levels.
